context: Adds a countEmailMatches helper and a validateEmailList batch validator, adding the g flag to the shared EMAIL_PATTERN regex so it can also be used with String.match for counting.
explanation: Adding the global flag to a regex that's reused across calls to .test() makes it stateful: with /g, .test() advances the regex's lastIndex on a match and resumes searching from there on the next call. validateEmailList calls isValidEmail repeatedly on the same shared EMAIL_PATTERN, so alternating valid/invalid results start appearing depending on call order and previous lastIndex position, even for emails that are individually valid. Use a fresh regex per call, drop the g flag from the test pattern, or reset lastIndex = 0 before every use.
